name: off-when-bedroom-sensor-is-stale
comment: Do not trust a dead room. The bedroom Room Sensor is a BLE satellite of the pod; when it stops reporting, its last motion and temperature readings freeze at whatever they were, so an occupancy or threshold rule keeps 'seeing' a room it can no longer measure. Rather than cool an empty room on stale data, this rule turns the AC off as soon as the sensor's persisted health says down/unknown, or its last good reading is older than 900s (the health default). Pair it with 'sensibo health list' to see why it fired.
